questions.question: To study the demands of the reorganisation of states on linguistic basis, a committee was formed by the Indian National Congress in 1948. The committee was headed by:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**S.K. Dhar**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• To study the demands of the **reorganization of states on a linguistic basis**, a committee was formed by the Indian National Congress in **1948**.
 
• The committee was headed by **S.K. Dhar.**

**Linguistic Provision Commission:-**

 
• **Linguistic Provinces Commission (aka Dhar Commission)** was set up in **June 1948 **to look into the demands of state reorganization on a linguistic basis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**States Reorganisation Commission:-**

 
• It succeeded in the **Linguistic Provinces Commission**.
 
• It was appointed by the then Prime Minister **Jawaharlal Nehru** in **December 1953**.
 
• The commission was headed by the **retired Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, Fazal Ali.**
 
• Its other two members were **H. N. Kunzru** and **K. M. Panikkar.**
 
• The efforts of the commission were overseen by **Govind Ballabh Pant**, the then Home Minister.

**Tracing the demand for states on the linguistic basis:-**

 
• The demand for states to be organized on a linguistic basis was developed even before India achieved independence from British rule.
 
• A first-of-its-kind linguistic movement started in **1895**, in what is now **Odisha.**
 
• The movement gained momentum in later years with the demand for a separate Orissa Province to be formed by bifurcating the existing Bihar and Orissa Province.
 
• Due to the efforts of **Madhusudan Das**, the **Father of Odia nationalism**, **Orissa Province became the first Indian state (pre-independence) to be organized on the basis of common languages.**

questions.question: Which of the following is an independent Indian Satellite based positioning system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __NAVIC__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NAVIC** is an independent Indian **Satellite based positioning system.**

**NAVIC**

 
• It is an acronym for **NAVigation with Indian Constellation.**
 
• It is the operational name of the **Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System** (**IRNSS**).
 
• It covers India and a region extending** 1,500 km around it**, with plans for further extension.
 
• The system is intended to provide an absolute position accuracy of better than **10 meters (33 ft**) throughout the Indian landmass and better than **20 meters (66 ft) **in the region extending approximately 1,500 km (930 mi) around India.
 
• The system currently consists of a constellation of **seven satellites**, with two additional satellites on the ground as stand-by.
 
• NAVIC will provide two levels of service, the **"standard positioning service", **which will be open for civilian use, and a** "restricted service"** (an encrypted one) for authorized users (including the military).
 
• **NAVIC** is planned to become available for civilian use in the **first half of 2020.**
 
• The **system was developed partly because access to foreign government-controlled global navigation satellite systems is not guaranteed in hostile situations.**
 
• A similar thing happened to the **Indian military** in **1999 **when **it was dependent on the American Global Positioning System (GPS) during the Kargil War.**

__
 
• **Windows Media Player **is software is used for running **MP4 files** on a computer.

**MP4 files:**

 
• A file with the .mp4 file extension is a **MPEG-4 video file format.**
 
• MP4s are one of the more common video file formats used for downloading and streaming **videos **from the internet.
 
• It’s a** highly versatile and compressed video format** that also can store audio, subtitles, and still images.

questions.question: If a coastal area is affected by a high tide at 5 AM on Tuesday, it should normally experience next high tide at:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 5:25 PM Tuesday**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If a coastal area is affected by a** high tide** at **5 AM on Tuesday**, it should normally experience the next high tide at **5.25 PM Tuesday.**
 
• Most coastal areas, with some exceptions, **experience two high tides and two low tides every lunar day.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**Lunar day:-**

__
 
• **​**__Unlike a solar day (which is of 24 hours), a lunar day is **24 hours and 50 minutes.**
 
• The lunar day is 50 minutes longer than a solar day because the moon revolves around the Earth in the same direction that the Earth rotates around its axis.
 
• So, it takes the Earth an extra 50 minutes to “catch up” to the moon.
 
• Because the Earth experiences two tidal “bulges” every lunar day, coastal areas experience two high and two low tides every 24 hours and 50 minutes.
 
• Hence, any two High tides occur **12 hours and 25 minutes apart. **
 
• It takes **six hours and 12.5 minutes** for the water at the shore to go from high to low, or from low to high.

**Spring tides:-**

 
• During** full or new moons**, which occur when the Earth, sun, and moon are nearly in alignment.
 
• This occurs twice each month.
 
• In both cases, **the gravitational pull of the sun is "added" to the gravitational pull of the moon on Earth.**
 
• It causes the oceans to** bulge a bit more than usual. **
 
• This means that high tides are a little higher and low tides are a little lower than average.

**Neap Tides:-**

questions.question: The formation of rainbow is NOT due to the ______ of light by suspended tiny water droplets.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Absorption**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The formation of the rainbow is **not** due to the absorption of light by suspended tiny water droplets.

**Rainbow:-**

 
• A rainbow is a **multi-colored, arc-shaped** phenomenon that appears in the sky.
 
• The colors of a rainbow are produced by the **refraction**, **reflection, **and **dispersion **of light through water droplets present in the atmosphere.
 
• An observer may perceive a rainbow to be located either near or far away, **however, this phenomenon is not actually located at any specific spot**.
 
• Instead, the appearance of a rainbow** depends entirely upon the position of the observer in relation to the direction of light.****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22f0ec758063413822879282fb412b3751ce81d34c5a142a17f3b0ffca848eb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Formation:**

 
• A rainbow is formed when light passes through water droplets hanging in the atmosphere.
 
• The light waves change direction as they pass through the water droplets, resulting in two processes: **reflection **and **refraction**.
 
• When sunlight encounters a raindrop, part of the light is reflected and the rest enters the raindrop.
 
• The light is refracted at the surface of the raindrop. When this light hits the back of the raindrop, some of it is reflected off the back.
 
• When the internally reflected light reaches the surface again, once more some is internally reflected and some is refracted as it exits the drop.
 
• Since the white light is separated inside of the water, the refracted light appears as separate colors to the human eye.

questions.question: In the context of demographic history of India, which of the following years is known as the ‘Year of Great Divide’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1921**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In the context of the demographic history of India, **1921** is known as the **‘Year of Great Divide’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0686205f14af771f30469f74c1709201bea3430d80c3f4a8c7b3a8f34b41032.png] 

**There are three stages of population growth-**

**1. The high rate of birth and High rate of deaths** - Low population growth – due to widespread illiteracy, poor sanitation, and health care conditions, and negligible knowledge of family planning.

**2. The high rate of birth and Low rate of deaths** - High population growth – due to improvement in health-care, education, disease control, and so on, which in turn contribute to reducing the death rates.

**3. Low rate of birth and Low rate of deaths **- Low population growth – As after achieving a good level of economic growth and a better literacy rate, people tend to have fewer children.

 
• Till, 1921, there was **no significant and clear trend** in population growth.
 
• Before this year, the population was not stable, **sometimes it increased and at other times it decreased. **
 
• But after this year, there has been a considerable and continuous increase in the population.
 
• ​The trend has clearly been of positive growth.
 
• 1921, thus, marked the transition from stage 1 (high birth rate, high death rate) to stage 2 (high birth rate, Low death rate) for India.
